problem: Before driving into the desert, the Haddad family packed 24 bottles of water so that nobody would go thirsty. Nine of the bottles had been frozen overnight to keep the others cool. The rest came straight from the shop shelf. How many bottles came straight from the shop?

follow_ups.question: By lunchtime the family had drunk 7 of the shop bottles. How many shop bottles were still full?

problem: Grandpa Kofi has kept bees for 6 years, and every autumn he takes honey from his two oldest hives. This autumn the first hive filled 13 jars and the second hive filled 18 jars. What is the total number of jars he filled?

follow_ups.question: He gave 5 jars to the neighbours who let his bees visit their orchard. How many jars does he have now?
Then he sold half of his jars at the Saturday market. How many jars did he sell?

problem: In the tack room at Willow Stable, 74 horseshoes hang on the wall. The farrier sorted them by size so she could find the right ones quickly: 38 are small enough for ponies, and the rest fit the big horses. Work out how many horseshoes fit the big horses.

For the school play about a lost dragon, the children made paper lanterns to light up the stage. The younger children made 17 lanterns and the older children made 22. The lanterns glowed red under the lights. Altogether, how many lanterns did the children make?

follow_ups.question: During the show, 4 lanterns fell down. How many lanterns were still hanging?

problem: Every morning Nadia collects eggs from the coop for her family's breakfast. Today she found 20 eggs in the nests. Her brown hens laid 12 of them, and her white hens laid the others. How many eggs did the white hens lay?

follow_ups.question: Her mum cracked 6 of the eggs into a big omelette. How many eggs were left?
Then a neighbour brought over 10 eggs from her own hens. How many eggs are in the kitchen now?
Nadia packs all of them into boxes that hold a dozen each. How many boxes does she fill?

problem: A strong wind blew across the vegetable patch last night, so Ms Ortega went out early to check her beans. She found 57 bean plants left standing in the east bed and 68 left standing in the west bed. How many bean plants were left standing in all?

follow_ups.question: She wants to tie every standing plant to its own stick, and she has 90 sticks. How many more sticks does she need?
Her neighbour brings her 40 sticks. Once every plant has a stick, how many sticks will be spare?

problem: Liang lined up 32 flower pots on the greenhouse shelf. He sowed tomato seeds in 15 pots because tomatoes are his dad's favourite, and he filled the other pots with pepper seeds. Find the number of pots with pepper seeds.

follow_ups.question: A week later, 9 of the pepper pots had little green shoots. How many pepper pots had not sprouted yet?

problem: For her birthday Aiyana got a sticker album with 40 pages. So far she has filled it with 26 animal stickers and 19 space stickers. How many stickers are in the album?
Mr Lindqvist collects stamps only from Europe and Asia. When he counted his album last night, it held 93 stamps. If 58 of them come from Europe, how many come from Asia?

follow_ups.question: He swaps 12 of his Asian stamps for a rare stamp from Brazil. How many Asian stamps does he have left?
His granddaughter then gives him 17 Asian stamps from her trip to Japan. How many Asian stamps does he have now?

problem: It was kite day at the beach, and the wind was just right. Sami counted 14 diamond kites and 23 box kites in the sky. Ice cream vans were parked all along the road. What total did Sami get?

follow_ups.question: Then the strings of 8 box kites got tangled and they came down. How many of the kites Sami counted were still flying?

problem: Mrs Petrova's bakery bakes rolls for the school lunch. Today the school asked for 50 rolls. She has already baked 28, and the rest are still in the oven. How many rolls are still in the oven?

follow_ups.question: When the oven rolls come out, 2 of them are burnt, so she throws them away. How many good rolls came out of the oven?
How many good rolls does she have now, counting the ones she baked first?
How many more rolls must she bake so the school gets every roll it asked for?

problem: Uncle Juma counts his sheep each evening before he shuts the gate. There are 16 sheep in the top field. The bottom field has fewer, just 9 sheep. How many sheep does he count altogether?

follow_ups.question: In spring, 7 lambs are born. How many sheep and lambs are on the farm now?

problem: A camel caravan set off across the desert to trade at a market town. The camels carried 84 sacks, and each sack held either dates or salt. If 47 sacks held salt, what number of sacks held dates?

follow_ups.question: At the market the traders sold 20 sacks of dates. How many sacks of dates did they still have?
For the trip home the camels carried those date sacks and 25 sacks of cloth. How many sacks did the camels carry home?

problem: Amira walked through the clover field next to her 3 beehives to see where her bees were feeding. How many bees did she count if 21 were on white clover and 34 were on purple clover?
Green Hill Stable has 27 horses. On Sunday morning, 14 of them went out on a trail ride with the riding club. The rest stayed in their stalls. Can you work out how many horses stayed behind?

follow_ups.question: Later a stable girl led 5 of the resting horses out to the field to graze. How many horses were still in their stalls?

problem: An hour before the puppet show, the manager of the Rosewood Theater checked the booking chart. There were 64 seats left downstairs and 49 seats left in the balcony. How many seats were left for people buying tickets at the door?

follow_ups.question: At the door, 80 people bought tickets. How many seats stayed empty?
The ushers had 50 spare programs and put one on every empty seat. How many programs did they have left over?

problem: Lars is painting the fence around the chicken coop to keep the wood from rotting. The fence has 40 boards. By lunch he had painted 26 of them. How many boards are still unpainted?

follow_ups.question: After lunch Lars paints 9 more boards. How many boards are still unpainted now?
His sister paints the last boards. How many boards did Lars paint in total?
How many more boards did Lars paint than his sister?

problem: Kemal and his grandmother pulled carrots from the vegetable patch for the Sunday soup. Kemal pulled 18 and his grandmother pulled 25. A rabbit watched them from under the hedge. Together, how many carrots did they pull?

follow_ups.question: Grandmother put 13 carrots in the soup. How many carrots were left for later?

problem: The greenhouse at Oakfield School has 96 seed trays. For the spring fair, the children sowed sunflowers in 59 trays and marigolds in all the others. What is the number of marigold trays?

follow_ups.question: At the fair they sold 25 marigold trays. How many marigold trays did they keep?
They also kept 18 sunflower trays for the school garden. How many trays did they keep altogether?

problem: Hugo trades stickers with his friends every Friday. Right now he has 31 shiny stickers and 17 glitter stickers, all kept in a tin that cost 8 dollars. Altogether, how many shiny and glitter stickers does he own?
Priya's grandmother sent her an envelope of old stamps from India. Inside were 22 stamps with birds on them and 16 stamps with flowers. What was the number of stamps in the envelope?

follow_ups.question: Priya stuck 10 of them into her album straight away. How many stamps are still in the envelope?

problem: A stall at the kite festival opens at 9 in the morning with 45 kites for sale. Some are shaped like birds, and 21 look like fish. Find the number of bird kites at the stall.

follow_ups.question: By noon, 6 bird kites had been sold. How many bird kites were not sold yet?
The owner then brought 12 more bird kites from her van. How many bird kites could she sell now?

problem: The town festival lasts all weekend, so Baker Yusuf made extra pies. He baked 68 apple pies and 75 cherry pies. Find the total number of pies he baked.
Mila's family keeps 35 cows on their farm. Twelve of the cows are black, and the others are brown with white spots. The farm dog loves to run beside them. How many cows are brown with white spots?

problem: On their desert trip, Leila and her dad hunted for stones that the wind had polished smooth. Leila found 19 smooth stones and her dad found 24. Between them, how many smooth stones did they find?

follow_ups.question: They gave 10 of the stones to their guide as a thank-you. How many stones did they keep?

Her dad has paint for only 9 more stones. If he paints them, how many stones will still be unpainted?

problem: Mr Okafor runs a bee farm, and each summer he moves some hives so his bees can visit new flowers. Altogether he has 72 hives. This summer 45 of them stand beside the lavender field and the rest stand in the apple orchard. How many hives stand in the orchard?

follow_ups.question: Every orchard hive has 2 honey boxes on top. How many honey boxes are in the orchard?
He has already collected honey from 30 of those boxes. How many boxes still have to be emptied?

problem: How many saddles hang in the tack room at Ridgeway Stable if there are 12 English saddles and 9 western saddles?

follow_ups.question: The riding teacher takes 4 saddles out for a lesson. How many saddles are still hanging?

problem: The dressing room of the town theater holds 48 costumes. Tonight's play starts at 7 o'clock and needs 29 of the costumes. The rest are saved for next month's show. Work out how many costumes are being saved for next month.
Farmer Ines keeps track of what her hens eat so she knows when to buy more feed. This month they ate 47 kilograms of corn and 58 kilograms of wheat. How much feed did the hens eat this month?

follow_ups.question: Next month she plans to buy 15 kilograms more than they ate this month. How many kilograms will she buy?
The shop sells feed in bags of 10 kilograms. How many bags must she buy?

problem: Aunt Rosa grows 30 lettuce plants in her vegetable patch. Slugs chewed holes in 8 of them, but the others look perfect. Slugs mostly come out after it rains. How many lettuce plants look perfect?

follow_ups.question: She picks 6 of the perfect ones for a salad. How many perfect plants are still growing?

problem: Ama keeps her cactus collection in a warm greenhouse because cacti hate the cold. She has 13 round cacti and 21 tall cacti. Find the total number of cacti in her collection.

follow_ups.question: Her friend gives her 4 tiny cacti for her birthday. How many cacti does she have now?
She moves half of them to the sunny windowsill at home. How many cacti does she move?
How many cacti stay in the greenhouse?

problem: Ji-woo and her brother Min keep their stickers in one shoebox under the bed. Altogether there are 40 stickers in the box. Ji-woo says 25 of them are hers. How many stickers belong to Min?

follow_ups.question: Min buys a sheet of 12 new stickers. How many stickers does Min have now?

problem: The stamp club at the library keeps its collection in a red album and a green album. The red album holds 86 stamps and the green album holds 79. Find how many stamps the club owns.

follow_ups.question: At the club fair, members sold 45 of the stamps. How many stamps does the club own now?

problem: Ravi's kite spool holds 50 metres of string. On kite day he let out 32 metres so his kite could fly high above the trees, and the rest stayed on the spool. His kite has 6 ribbons on its tail. How much string stayed on the spool?

The Little Oven bakery opens early so workers can grab breakfast on the way to work. This morning the counter shows 27 blueberry muffins and 18 banana muffins. Count them up: how many muffins are on the counter?

follow_ups.question: By eight o'clock, 20 muffins had been sold. How many muffins were still on the counter?

problem: Every evening Hoang walks down to the pond on his farm to count the birds before the fox comes out. Tonight he counted a total of 91 ducks and geese. He knows 54 of them are ducks. How many geese are on the pond?

problem: Zara's class went on a trip to the desert to learn about lizards. They spotted 11 lizards sunning on the rocks and 17 lizards hiding in the sand. How many lizards did the class spot?

For the class poster, Zara will draw half of all the lizards they saw. How many will she draw?

problem: Signe's beehive has 36 wooden frames inside. Her bees have filled 20 frames with honey, and the others are still empty. The hive sits under an old apple tree. How many frames are still empty?

follow_ups.question: One week later the bees have filled 7 more frames. How many frames are empty now?

problem: The stable stores its oats in two big bins so the horses never run short. The front bin holds 65 scoops and the back bin holds 48 scoops. Work out how many scoops of oats the stable has.

follow_ups.question: This week the horses eat 30 scoops. How many scoops are left?
Then the stable buys a sack with 16 scoops in it. How many scoops does it have now?

problem: The puppet theater keeps 42 puppets in a big trunk. Each show lasts 45 minutes and uses every puppet. 18 of the puppets are animals; the others are people such as kings and farmers. How many puppets are people?

Kwame's family keeps 26 chickens in a coop beside the house. On a sunny afternoon, 11 chickens stay inside to lay eggs while the others go out to scratch in the yard. So how many chickens are out in the yard?

follow_ups.question: Then 3 of the yard chickens go back inside. How many chickens are inside the coop now?

problem: Sofia wants to grow food for her pet rabbit, so she dug a vegetable patch 5 metres long. She planted 24 bean seeds and 28 pea seeds in it. How many seeds did she plant?

follow_ups.question: Only 40 of the seeds sprouted. How many seeds did not sprout?
Sofia plants a new seed for each one that did not sprout, plus 6 extra just in case. How many new seeds does she plant?

problem: The orchid house in the botanical garden has 81 orchids. Visitors may only see the 46 that are in bloom; the rest wait in a back room until they flower. What number of orchids are waiting in the back room?

Mateo's teacher gives out stickers for neat handwriting. This term Mateo has earned 15 star stickers and 12 smiley stickers. He keeps them on the cover of his reading folder. How many stickers has he earned this term?

problem: Hana is sorting 60 stamps from her grandfather's old letters. She makes one pile of stamps with ships, and it has 35 stamps. The rest of the stamps show trains. How many train stamps does she have?

follow_ups.question: Hana gives 5 train stamps to her cousin. How many train stamps does she have left?
Her grandfather finds 14 more ship stamps in a drawer and gives them to her. How many ship stamps does Hana have now?
How many ship and train stamps does she have now altogether?

problem: On kite day the kite shop sold 56 kites in the morning. In the afternoon the wind dropped, so the shop sold fewer: only 39 kites. What was the shop's kite total for the day?

follow_ups.question: The shop had 99 kites when it opened. How many kites did it have left when it closed?
The owner wants 80 kites in the shop for next weekend. How many kites must she order?

problem: Ibrahim helps at his aunt's bakery after school. He had a tray of 24 cookies to decorate. He covered 10 with pink icing, and the others got chocolate chips because his sister likes those best. How many cookies got chocolate chips?

follow_ups.question: His sister ate 2 of the chocolate chip cookies. How many chocolate chip cookies are left on the tray?

problem: Farmer Greta's tractor is 12 years old, but it still pulled two loads of hay into the barn today. The first load had 33 bales and the second had 29. How many bales did the tractor bring in?

A desert ranger counts the birds at a small oasis each morning to see if the water is still clean. Today she counted 73 birds; 28 were doves and the rest were finches. Find how many finches were at the oasis.

follow_ups.question: A loud truck drove past and scared away 19 of the finches. How many finches stayed?
How many birds stayed at the oasis altogether?

problem: Ezra's class visited a bee farm, and the beekeeper lifted the lids off two hives. Ezra counted 16 bees on the first lid and 25 bees on the second. The beekeeper's hat had a net to keep the bees off her face. How many bees did Ezra count?

follow_ups.question: Then 9 of those bees flew away. How many bees were left on the lids?

problem: Pita brushes the ponies at the riding stable every Saturday. There are 22 ponies, and 9 of them are grey. All the other ponies are brown. How many brown ponies does Pita brush?

follow_ups.question: Each brown pony gets 2 carrots after brushing. How many carrots does Pita need for the brown ponies?
He has a bag of 30 carrots. How many carrots will be left after the brown ponies eat?
He gives the leftover carrots to the grey ponies, one each. How many grey ponies get no carrot?

problem: When the musical ended, the cleaners walked through the theater. They found 14 gloves left on the seats and 9 hats left in the aisles. What is the number of things people left behind?

follow_ups.question: The next day, owners came back for 11 of the things. How many things are still in the lost-and-found box?

problem: Farmer Ade is building a new coop, and the plan says it needs 95 nails. He has a jar of 58 nails in his shed and will buy the others at the hardware shop. How many nails must he buy?

follow_ups.question: At the shop he buys 40 nails to be safe. How many spare nails will he have when the coop is done?
He uses the spare nails and 12 more to fix the gate. How many nails does the gate take?

problem: Yara helped dig up potatoes in the vegetable patch so her family could store them for winter. It took her 3 hours. She dug 32 potatoes from one row and 26 from the other. Find how many potatoes she dug.

A greenhouse by the road grows strawberries for the Saturday market. Of its 45 strawberry plants, 17 still only have flowers. The others already have ripe berries. On how many plants are the berries ripe?

follow_ups.question: The gardener picks berries from 20 of the ripe plants today. How many ripe plants still need picking?

problem: Noor's sticker book fell in a puddle and she lost a few stickers, but 64 were still fine on the first page and 57 were still fine on the second page. How many stickers were still fine?

follow_ups.question: She moves 21 of the good stickers onto her school box. How many stickers are left in the book?
Half of the stickers left in the book are animals. How many animal stickers are in the book?

problem: Every stamp in Oskar's small album comes from either Sweden or Norway. The album holds 32 stamps, and 18 of them are Swedish. How many Norwegian stamps does Oskar have?

follow_ups.question: His uncle in Oslo sends him 6 more Norwegian stamps. How many Norwegian stamps does Oskar have now?
How many stamps are in the album now?
The album has 40 spaces. How many spaces are still empty?

problem: Mr Sato's class made 19 kites and Ms Brandt's class made 13 kites for the school kite day. The kites were made from old newspaper and bamboo sticks. Find the total number of kites the two classes made.

follow_ups.question: On the windy hill, 6 of the kites broke. How many kites were still good?

problem: The baker packed a box of 84 bagels for a big office breakfast. Some were plain, and 39 had sesame seeds on top. How many plain bagels were in the box?

follow_ups.question: The office workers ate 37 of the plain bagels. How many plain bagels were left?
They also ate all but 5 of the sesame bagels. How many sesame bagels did they eat?

problem: Two fields on the farm grow pumpkins for the autumn fair, where each pumpkin will sell for 4 dollars. The east field has 27 pumpkins and the west field has 35. How many pumpkins are growing on the farm?
How many tents stood at the desert camp? There were 14 tents for the tourists and 8 tents for the guides, all set up in a circle around the fire.

follow_ups.question: A sandstorm blew down 5 of the tents. How many tents were still standing?

problem: Valentina sells honey from her bee farm at a stall by the road. Today she brought 40 jars. Sixteen were small jars and the rest were big jars, which cost 9 euros each. How many big jars did she bring?

follow_ups.question: She sold 15 big jars by noon. How many big jars were left?
Nobody bought a small jar. How many jars did she take home?

problem: Builders are putting up a new fence along two sides of the stable's paddock. One side needs 48 posts and the other side needs 67 posts. What is the total number of posts the builders need?

The children's choir had 30 singers for the winter concert at the town theater. Some stood on the stage steps, and 18 stood in the back row. The curtains behind them were dark blue velvet. Work out the number of singers on the steps.

follow_ups.question: Before the last song, 3 singers moved from the steps to the back row. How many singers were in the back row then?

problem: Nina's grandma has a small coop by the garden and a big coop by the barn. There are 9 hens in the small coop and 24 hens in the big one. In total, how many hens does grandma have?

follow_ups.question: One night a fox got into the big coop and took 2 hens. How many hens were left in the big coop?
Grandma bought 7 new hens for the big coop. How many hens are in the big coop now?
How many hens does she have in both coops now?

problem: Mr Mbeki grows tomatoes and peppers in his vegetable patch to make his famous sauce. In all, the patch has 75 plants, and 49 of them are tomato plants. How many pepper plants does he grow?

follow_ups.question: This week each pepper plant gave him 3 peppers. How many peppers did he pick?
His sauce needs 60 peppers. How many peppers will be spare?

problem: Find the number of plant pots in Elif's greenhouse: 26 clay pots stand on the floor and 17 plastic pots hang from the roof.

follow_ups.question: Elif cracks 4 of the clay pots while moving them. How many pots are not cracked?

problem: For his space party, Lucas bought a pack of 50 stickers that cost 3 dollars. To his surprise, 33 of the stickers were dinosaurs. The rest were planets, and he gave those to his guests. How many planet stickers did his guests get?

At the stamp fair, a dealer laid out his stamps on two tables so collectors could look through them. One table had 85 stamps with animals and the other had 49 stamps with famous buildings. How many stamps were on the two tables?

follow_ups.question: Collectors bought 76 of the stamps. How many stamps did the dealer have left?
Then a woman sold him her collection of 50 stamps. How many stamps does the dealer have now?

problem: Twenty kites were flying over the field on kite day. Eight of them had long ribbon tails, and the rest had no tails at all. A dog ran around the field barking at them. How many kites had no tails?

follow_ups.question: Then 5 more kites without tails went up. How many kites without tails were flying now?

problem: Chiara's bakery is famous for its bread, so she bakes it in two ovens. The stone oven bakes 21 loaves and the steel oven bakes 26 loaves. Together, the two ovens bake how many loaves?

follow_ups.question: She keeps 7 loaves for her cafe. How many loaves can she sell in the shop?
By noon she has sold 32 loaves. How many loaves are still for sale?
A school calls and orders 10 loaves. How many more loaves must she bake to fill the order?

problem: When it rains, Farmer Lina brings her goats and pigs into the barn. Together there are 33 animals in the barn now. Fifteen are goats. How many are pigs?

follow_ups.question: When the rain stops, 6 pigs run out to roll in the mud. How many pigs are still in the barn?

problem: A tour group drove across the desert to see the giant sand dunes. On the first day they drove 78 kilometres, and on the second day they drove 64 kilometres. How far did they drive in the two days?

follow_ups.question: On the third day they drove 35 kilometres back to town. How far did they drive on the whole trip?
How much farther did they drive on the first day than on the third day?

problem: A bee farm that opened 8 years ago has 46 hives along the river. Twenty-nine of the hives are painted yellow, and the others are white. How many white hives are there?
Two riding groups visit Maplewood Stable on Saturdays. The morning group has 12 riders and the afternoon group has 15 riders. Work out how many riders come on a Saturday.

follow_ups.question: On Sunday, 8 fewer riders come than on Saturday. How many riders come on Sunday?

problem: The Globe Street theater put on the same play twice on Sunday, once in the afternoon and once at night. Both shows together sold 92 tickets. If the afternoon show sold 57, how many tickets did the night show sell?

follow_ups.question: Night show tickets cost 4 dollars each. How much money did the night show bring in?

problem: Chen's ducks and chickens kept wandering onto the road, so he built them one big coop. He has 13 ducks and 18 chickens. How many birds live in the new coop?

follow_ups.question: Chen gives 4 ducks to his cousin. How many ducks does he have now?
How many birds live in the coop now?
The coop has room for 35 birds. How many more birds could fit?

problem: Ms Duarte's class planted a vegetable patch next to the playground. It has 28 seedlings: 13 are squash and the rest are beans. The children take turns with the watering can. Find the number of bean seedlings.

follow_ups.question: Snails eat 4 of the bean seedlings. How many bean seedlings are left?

problem: A flower farmer grows roses in two greenhouses so she has flowers all winter. She cut 66 roses in the first greenhouse and 59 in the second. How many roses did she cut altogether?

follow_ups.question: She ties the roses into bunches of 5. How many bunches does she make?
A florist buys 18 of the bunches. How many bunches are left for the market?

problem: Tevita is 7 years old and already has 38 stickers in his collection. 21 of them are football stickers. The others are cartoon stickers. How many cartoon stickers does he have?
How many of Abebe's stamps have animals on them? He has 43 stamps from Ethiopia. 25 of them show famous runners and all the others show animals.

follow_ups.question: His friend gives him 9 more animal stamps. How many animal stamps does he have now?

problem: The kite club met on the hill at 10 o'clock. Its members brought 15 red kites and 18 yellow kites. How many kites did they bring?

follow_ups.question: The wind was weak, so only 20 kites got up into the air. How many kites stayed on the ground?

problem: The bakery had to make 90 cupcakes for a wedding. By the end of the morning, 63 were iced and the rest were still cooling on racks. Find the number of cupcakes that were still cooling.

follow_ups.question: She took 12 apples home to bake a pie. How many apples stayed at the farm?

problem: A desert camp has 30 sleeping bags for its guests. To keep sand out of them, 14 bags are stored in the big tent and the rest are stored in the jeep. How many sleeping bags are in the jeep?

follow_ups.question: A family of 5 arrives, and each of them takes a sleeping bag from the jeep. How many bags are left in the jeep?

problem: The bee farm sold 85 jars of honey in summer. In autumn it sold 37 jars, a lot less, because the flowers had faded. How many jars did it sell in summer and autumn?

follow_ups.question: In winter it sold 28 more jars. How many jars did it sell in the three seasons?

problem: Carlos fills the water buckets at the stable each morning. The horses need 18 buckets, and he has filled 11 so far. How many more buckets does he have to fill?

follow_ups.question: While he works, a horse kicks over 2 full buckets. How many buckets must he fill now?

problem: The theater's ticket office opens 2 hours before each show. On Friday it sold 36 tickets online and 27 tickets at the window. How many tickets did the office sell on Friday?
The farm shop sells eggs from its own coop. On Tuesday it had 96 eggs to sell, and 58 of them were brown. The rest were white. How many white eggs did the shop have?

follow_ups.question: Customers bought all but 6 of the white eggs. How many white eggs did they buy?

problem: Rustam and his little sister weeded the vegetable patch before their grandmother came to visit. Rustam pulled 34 weeds and his sister pulled 21. Grandmother brought them a jar of cherry jam. Find the number of weeds they pulled.

follow_ups.question: They put all the weeds into a compost bin that already held 30 weeds. How many weeds are in the bin now?

problem: A greenhouse grows herbs for the restaurant next door. It has 40 pots of herbs: 22 pots are basil and the rest are mint. How many pots of mint does it have?

follow_ups.question: The chef takes 6 mint pots into the kitchen. How many mint pots stay in the greenhouse?

problem: Imre's little brother peeled a lot of stickers out of his book. Now only 26 stickers remain on the blue page and 19 remain on the green page. How many stickers remain in the book?

follow_ups.question: Imre buys a pack of 15 new stickers to fill the gaps. How many stickers will the book have then?

problem: For show-and-tell, Esi brought her stamp collection of 87 stamps. 49 of the stamps are from Ghana and the rest are from other countries. How many stamps are from other countries?

follow_ups.question: Her teacher gives her 14 more stamps from other countries. How many stamps from other countries does she have now?
How many stamps does Esi have now in total?

problem: Kite day is held on the beach on the 5th of May. This year Malik sold 24 kites in the morning and 31 kites in the afternoon at his stall. How many kites did he sell?
The bakery window shows 36 cakes. Some are birthday cakes and 15 are wedding cakes. How many birthday cakes are in the window?

follow_ups.question: A customer buys 3 birthday cakes for her triplets. How many birthday cakes are left in the window?

problem: Because of the dry summer, Farmer Bjorn's corn field gave fewer bags than last year: 76 bags from the north part and 58 bags from the south part. How many bags of corn did the field give this year?

follow_ups.question: He feeds 45 bags to his cows over the winter. How many bags are left?

problem: Ali packed 25 snacks for a day in the desert because there are no shops out there. Twelve of the snacks were dates and the others were nut bars. How many nut bars did he pack?
